description: Ex-RAAF 10 Squadron. Storm damaged in Cyclone Yasi 03/2011, restored using A89-272 as a spares source, and replaced A89-272 as the RAAF Townsville gate guard in 10/2012. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.

Flew with 38 Squadron in United Nations markings with UNMOGIP in Kashmir 1975-78. Airlifted to Townsville by Chinook A15-102 on 18/11/2009 after a hard landing and now the base gate guardian. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.

Served with the United Nations Emergency Force II in Egypt 1976-79 and the Multinational Force and Observers in the Sinai 1982-86. Gate guard of 5th Aviation Regiment inside the Duckworth Street entrance to RAAF Base Townsville. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials.
